title: South Africa, provinces
time_reference: Financial year April to March; `year` is the START year (2024 = April 2024 to March 2025).
murder_text: SAPS defines murder as the unlawful and intentional killing of another human being.
manslaughter_text: SAPS lists culpable homicide, defined as the unlawful negligent causing of death of another human being, as a separate category. Whether SAPS places provoked intentional killings under murder is not stated.
attempts_text: Attempted murder is a separate SAPS category.
nonintent_text: Negligent killing is the SAPS category culpable homicide, separate from murder.
other_text: By definition murder is the killing of another human being, so suicide and abortion are not in it.
legal_text: By definition only unlawful killings are murder. The source does not say how deaths caused by police action are classified.

title: Nigeria, states
term: MURDER and MAN SLAUGHTER (two columns, added)
time_reference: Calendar year 2017 (the only edition read so far).
murder_text: 3,219 cases nationally in 2017.
manslaughter_text: 'Man slaughter' (120 cases nationally) is added to murder; whether it is voluntary or involuntary is not stated.
attempts_text: Attempted Murder is a column of its own in the NBS state tables of offences against persons.
nonintent_text: The list of offences against persons has no column for negligent or traffic deaths. Whether the 'Man Slaughter' column contains negligent killings is not stated.
other_text: Suicide and Attempted Suicide are columns of their own. The NBS description of offences against persons also names infanticide and concealment of birth, but the state tables give them no column, so where they are recorded is not stated.
legal_text: The NBS tables and its note on the police returns do not discuss legal intervention or justified killings.

title: Tanzania, regions
murder_text: 2,263 people murdered in 2,193 cases in 2024.
manslaughter_text: The report lists 'manslaughter' (25 in 2024) among the reasons for the killings it counts, so the table includes some killings the police classify as manslaughter.
attempts_text: The report lists murder, rape, unnatural offences and human trafficking in the category of offences against persons; no attempted-murder line is named.
attempts_source: https://www.nbs.go.tz/uploads/statistics/documents/en-1744876106-Crime and Traffic Incidents Statistics  January - December 2024.pdf
nonintent_text: Road traffic deaths are tabulated in a separate chapter of the same report (accidents, deaths and injured). Other negligent killings are not addressed.
nonintent_source: https://www.nbs.go.tz/uploads/statistics/documents/en-1744876106-Crime and Traffic Incidents Statistics  January - December 2024.pdf
other_text: Suicide and abortion are not named among the offences against persons the report lists.
other_source: https://www.nbs.go.tz/uploads/statistics/documents/en-1744876106-Crime and Traffic Incidents Statistics  January - December 2024.pdf
legal_text: The reasons listed for the killings in the murder table include 'extra judicial incidents' (405 of 2,263 in 2024), and the report has a separate table of extrajudicial killings by region (2015 to 2024). It does not say who the perpetrators are.
legal_source: https://www.nbs.go.tz/uploads/statistics/documents/en-1744876106-Crime and Traffic Incidents Statistics  January - December 2024.pdf

title: Lesotho, districts
murder_text: 944 cases nationally in 2022.
manslaughter_text: 'Culpable homicide' is reported as its own category among the general cases (50 in 2019).
attempts_text: 'Attempted murder' is a separate line (298 in 2022).
nonintent_text: Culpable homicide is separate.
other_text: The serious-case categories are armed robbery, assault with intent to cause grievous bodily harm, attempted murder, car theft, fraud, house breaking, human trafficking, murder, robbery, sexual offence and stock theft; there is none for suicide or abortion.
legal_text: The Bureau's report classifies the police's reported cases and does not discuss legal intervention.

title: Kenya, counties
murder_text: Murder was 61.5% of the category in 2021 (2,018 of 3,281) and 70.4% in 2017.
manslaughter_text: Manslaughter is a component (72 in 2021).
attempts_text: Attempted murder is not among the components the NPS and the NCRC list for the Homicide category (murder, manslaughter, infanticide, procuring abortion, concealing birth, suicide, causing death by dangerous driving).
nonintent_text: Causing death by dangerous driving (389 of 3,281 in 2021).
other_text: Suicide (658 in 2021), procuring abortion (32) and concealing birth (70). Infanticide (42) is also in the category but the ICCS includes infanticide.
legal_text: The NPS reports and the NCRC study do not discuss legal intervention or justified killings.

title: Bangladesh, metropolitan police units matched to cities
time_reference: Calendar year of FILING: the Police Headquarters compiles the statistics from the cases filed at police stations; over 400 of the 1,930 murder cases recorded in the first half of 2025 were filed for incidents of earlier years.
murder_text: The series is the 'Murder' category of the Police Headquarters' crime statistics (murder cases filed).
manslaughter_text: The police crime categories published are murder, robbery, dacoity, speedy-trial cases, rioting, violence against women and children, kidnapping, assault on police, burglary, theft and others; none is culpable homicide.
attempts_text: No attempted-murder category is named in the police headquarters' published list; where such cases are recorded is not stated.
nonintent_text: No category for deaths by negligence is named in the published list.
other_text: No category for suicide or abortion is named in the published list.
legal_text: The published statistics do not discuss legal intervention or justified killings.

country: China (Hong Kong SAR and mainland units)
title: China: Hong Kong SAR, Shanghai, Beijing, Jiangsu
murder_text: The series is the source's own homicide category: 'Homicide' in the Hong Kong Police Force tables and the 杀人 line of the yearbooks.
manslaughter_text: HKPF's 'Homicide' is murder plus manslaughter.
attempts_text: The Hong Kong Year Book police appendix lists 'Attempted murder' as a line of its own next to 'Murder and manslaughter'.
nonintent_text: HKPF's own annual reviews note that the figure can include deaths from, for example, dangerous driving and industrial accidents.
other_text: The violent-crime lines of the police tables (rape, indecent assault, murder and manslaughter, attempted murder, wounding, serious assault, robbery and others) have none for suicide or abortion.
legal_text: The police tables and the Year Book notes do not discuss legal intervention.

title: India, the 19 metropolitan cities
time_reference: Calendar year (the newest of the three years each edition prints).
murder_text: The NCRB crime head is 'Murder (Sec.302 IPC)'.
manslaughter_text: 'Culpable Homicide not amounting to Murder (Sec.304 IPC)' is a separate NCRB crime head. Under the Penal Code murder is the part of culpable homicide that has no mitigating exception; killings that fall under an exception of section 300 (grave and sudden provocation is one) are punished under section 304 and therefore sit outside the Murder head. The ICCS counts voluntary manslaughter of that kind as intentional homicide.
attempts_text: 'Attempt to commit Murder (Sec.307 IPC)' and 'Attempt to commit Culpable Homicide (Sec.308 IPC)' are separate heads.
nonintent_text: 'Causing Death by Negligence (Sec.304-A IPC)' is a separate head.
other_text: Dowry Deaths (Sec.304-B), Infanticide (Sec.315), Foeticide (Sec.316) and Abetment of Suicide (Sec.305/306) are separate heads. The ICCS includes dowry killings and infanticide in intentional homicide, so they are missing from the Murder head.
legal_text: The NCRB tables define the head only by the penal-code section; they do not say how deaths from lawful acts are treated.

title: Japan, prefectures
murder_text: The NPA offence group 殺人 contains 殺人罪 (murder).
manslaughter_text: 傷害致死罪 (injury resulting in death) is counted under 傷害 (injury), and 強盗殺人罪 (robbery-murder) under 強盗 (robbery), not under 殺人. The ICCS counts a death from a serious assault and a killing during a robbery as intentional homicide.
attempts_text: Attempts are counted with the completed offence (flag includes_attempts). 殺人予備罪 (preparation for murder) is also listed inside the 殺人 group.
nonintent_text: The Penal Code offence count excludes road-accident offences under article 211; those and the driving-death law are classified as special-law offences (特別法犯), outside the statistics used.
other_text: 自殺関与罪 (abetting suicide) is inside the 殺人 group, and the ICCS excludes assisting suicide; 嬰児殺 (infanticide) is inside as well, and the ICCS includes it.
legal_text: The NPA classification and notes list charges by name and do not discuss legal intervention.

title: Malaysia, states and districts
murder_text: The police index defines murder by section 300 of the Penal Code (Act 574), the intention-based form of culpable homicide; the police division that monitors murder data does so under section 302.
manslaughter_text: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder (section 304) is a separate offence of the Penal Code and is not in the series, which counts murder under section 302 only. The ICCS counts voluntary manslaughter of that kind as intentional homicide.
attempts_text: The series is murder under section 302 only; attempts are other offences (the data feed and the DOSM tables carry 'Murder' as the type).
nonintent_text: Causing death by negligence (section 304A) is a separate offence and is outside the murder series.
other_text: The police data exclude infanticide (section 309A) and child abandonment (section 317), which other police units monitor. The ICCS includes infanticide in intentional homicide, so the series is narrower on that point; suicide and abortion are not murder.
legal_text: The DOSM tables carry notes for rape (section 376) and robbery but none for murder, and no discussion of legal intervention.

title: Pakistan, districts and cities
time_reference: Calendar year; only full-year blocks are used (blocks titled with a month or quarter are excluded).
murder_text: The series is the 'Murder' column of the provincial police reports.
manslaughter_text: The provincial police reports have no column for the other kinds of qatl (qatl-i-khata, qatl-bis-sabab, qatl shibh-i-amd); where such cases are recorded (possibly under Miscellaneous or the accident columns) is not stated, and the files carry no notes.
attempts_text: The column is 'Murder', not 'attempted murder'.
nonintent_text: Every provincial report has a separate column for Traffic Accident (Sindh: Fatal Accident and Non-Fatal Accident). Other negligent killings are not addressed.
other_text: Suicide and Attempted Suicide (spelled 'Socide' in the files) are columns of their own.
legal_text: The files give no notes or definitions below the tables and do not discuss legal intervention.

title: Singapore (a city-state)
time_reference: Calendar year of REPORTING: SingStat states that its crime statistics are compiled from the offences reported to the police in the reference period, not from the date of the offence.
murder_text: 'Murder' is named among the selected major offences of the SingStat table.
manslaughter_text: SingStat's glossary names murder among the selected major offences and defines none of them. The Penal Code treats culpable homicide not amounting to murder as a distinct offence from murder, but whether the 'Murder' series includes it is not stated.
attempts_text: Not stated in the table or its glossary.
nonintent_text: Not stated in the table or its glossary.
other_text: Not stated in the table or its glossary.
legal_text: Not stated in the table or its glossary.

title: South Korea, cities and counties
time_reference: Calendar year (only 2025 is saved: the portal offers the newest release only).
murder_text: The five-crimes series 살인 includes homicide under the Criminal Act.
manslaughter_text: The police note lists the offences of the homicide chapter; where injury resulting in death and robbery-murder are counted is not stated (the series 폭력 is defined as extortion, damage, injury, assault, confinement, threat, abduction and violence offences).
attempts_text: The police definition says '미수, 교사, 방조, 예비 등 포함': attempts, instigation, aiding and preparation are included (flag includes_attempts). The national indicator portal says the domestic standard, unlike the international one, includes attempted murder and conspiracy.
nonintent_text: The list of included offences (homicide, infanticide, patricide, consent killing, aiding suicide, killing by deceit or force) contains no negligent killing.
other_text: Instigating or aiding suicide (자살교사·방조) is inside, and the ICCS excludes assisting suicide; infanticide (영아살해) is inside as well, and the ICCS includes it. Consensual killing (촉탁·승낙살인) is inside.
legal_text: The police note and the dataset metadata do not discuss legal intervention.

title: Taiwan, cities and counties
murder_text: The series is 'Homicide, cases known to the police' of the statistical yearbook, taken to be the police item 故意殺人 (see the note below).
manslaughter_text: The police definition of violent crime lists serious injury, 'including injury resulting in death', as an offence type of its own, separate from intentional homicide.
attempts_text: The police definition says intentional homicide excludes negligent death and says nothing about attempts; the counts are 'cases occurred', which include late-reported cases.
nonintent_text: The definition of violent crime reads 'intentional homicide (excluding negligent death)'.
other_text: By definition the item is the intentional killing of another person; the seven types of violent crime (intentional homicide, robbery, snatching, kidnapping for ransom, forcible sexual intercourse, serious extortion, serious injury) include no suicide or abortion.
legal_text: The definition does not discuss legal intervention or justified killings.

title: Thailand, provinces
murder_text: The series is the 'Murder (reported)' count of the National Statistical Office.
manslaughter_text: The Royal Thai Police criminal statistics keep 'Manslaughter' as a line of its own next to murder.
attempts_text: 'Attempted murder/homicide' is a separate line of the police statistics (several thousand cases a year, more than the murder line).
nonintent_text: 'Negligent Homicide' is a separate crime and is excluded.
other_text: The sources list murder, attempted murder, homicide, manslaughter, assault and rape among the offences against life, body and sex; suicide and abortion are not named.
legal_text: The police statistics and the NSO table do not discuss legal intervention.

title: Uzbekistan, 14 regions
murder_text: The indicator is 'registered intentional murders and attempted murders' (qasddan odam o'ldirish va o'ldirishga suiqasd holatlari; Russian: умышленные убийства и покушения на убийства), indicator 2.04.09.0036.
manslaughter_text: The indicator's metadata name only intentional killing and attempts; which provisions of the Criminal Code (provoked killing, excess of self-defence, infanticide) are counted as intentional killing is not stated.
attempts_text: Stated in the indicator's own name; flag includes_attempts.
nonintent_text: The indicator counts intentional killings ('умышленные'): negligent killings are not part of it.
other_text: The metadata mention neither suicide nor abortion.
legal_text: The metadata do not discuss legal intervention.

title: Eurostat, NUTS 3 regions
murder_text: The series is ICCS0101 Intentional homicide, the number of offences supplied by each country's police and statistical authorities.
manslaughter_text: Eurostat's wording lists manslaughter among the exclusions, while the ICCS itself includes VOLUNTARY manslaughter and excludes involuntary manslaughter: the national treatment decides (see the flag 'd').
attempts_text: Attempted homicide is a separate category (ICCS0102).
nonintent_text: Non-intentional homicide is a separate category of the ICCS (ICCS0103) and is not part of ICCS0101.
other_text: Suicide is not part of the series.
legal_text: Death due to legal intervention and justifiable homicide in self-defence are excluded; serious assault leading to death and terrorist attacks are included.

title: Eurostat, largest cities
murder_text: The series is the number of intentional homicides in the city, as supplied by each country's police and statistical authorities.
manslaughter_text: As for the regional series.
attempts_text: As for the regional series: attempted homicide is a separate category (ICCS0102).
nonintent_text: As for the regional series: non-intentional homicide is a separate category (ICCS0103).
other_text: As for the regional series: suicide is not part of the series.
legal_text: As for the regional series: death due to legal intervention and justifiable homicide in self-defence are excluded.

title: England and Wales, police force areas
time_reference: Financial year April to March, paired with the mid-year estimate of the starting year.
murder_text: The Home Office Counting Rules classify Murder (code 1) in the Homicide group.
manslaughter_text: Manslaughter (4/1) and corporate manslaughter (4/10) are in the Homicide group, so manslaughter of every kind is counted, including involuntary and corporate; the ICCS includes only voluntary manslaughter.
attempts_text: Attempted murder has its own Home Office offence code (2), separate from Murder (1) and Manslaughter (4/1).
nonintent_text: Deaths caused by unlawful driving form a separate group in the Counting Rules ('Death or Serious Injury - Unlawful Driving'), next to Homicide.
other_text: The Homicide classification lists murder, manslaughter, corporate manslaughter and infanticide; suicide and abortion are not in it. Infanticide is inside, as in the ICCS.
legal_text: The Counting Rules' Homicide classification does not discuss legal intervention.

title: Australia, states and territories
term: Murder + manslaughter (the ABS category 'Homicide' also contains attempted murder)
time_reference: Calendar year: the ABS Recorded Crime - Victims reference period is 1 January to 31 December.
murder_text: Murder is its own category (ANZSOC). The victim is an individual person; offences later found to be 'no crime' are excluded.
manslaughter_text: The collection covers manslaughter (ANZSOC 0131), which includes killings without intent through reckless, negligent or dangerous acts other than driving, infanticide, killing by excessive force in self-defence, surviving a suicide pact, assisting suicide and industrial or corporate manslaughter: broader than the ICCS's voluntary manslaughter.
attempts_text: Murder and attempted murder are separate categories (the one exception to counting attempts with the completed offence); the layer uses murder and manslaughter only.
nonintent_text: Driving causing death (0132) and conspiracy to murder are excluded from the collection's homicide group, but killings without intent by other reckless, negligent or dangerous acts are inside manslaughter.
other_text: Illegal abortion is coded to another group (1695), but assisting suicide and surviving a suicide pact are coded to manslaughter, which the ICCS excludes; infanticide is coded to manslaughter (the ICCS includes it).
legal_text: Killing by the use of excessive force in self-defence is coded to manslaughter (counted); lawful self-defence is not an offence. How deaths caused by police action are recorded is not stated.

title: New South Wales, local government areas
time_reference: Calendar year of REPORTING: BOCSAR dates a crime by the day it was reported to or detected by the police, not the day it occurred.
murder_text: Murder is the police incident category 'Murder - actual', counted by victim.
manslaughter_text: Manslaughter is the police category 'Manslaughter - actual' (driving causing death excluded), counted by victim. BOCSAR notes that police counts are very low because the distinction between murder and manslaughter is generally decided in court; in the quarter reports of 2023 manslaughter was 7 to 12 victims a year against 48 to 61 murder victims.
attempts_text: Attempted murder (police 'Murder - attempted' and 'Shoot with intent to murder') and murder accessory or conspiracy are separate categories.
nonintent_text: Driving causing death is a separate BOCSAR category. Other killings without intent that the police record as manslaughter are inside the manslaughter count.
other_text: The Homicide group of BOCSAR's reports consists of murder, attempted murder, murder accessory or conspiracy, manslaughter and driving causing death only.
legal_text: BOCSAR's definitions do not discuss legal intervention or justified killings.

title: Victoria, local government areas
murder_text: Group A11 Murder: unlawfully killing another person with intent to kill, or with intent to cause grievous bodily harm knowing that death or grievous harm was probable, or without intent to kill in the course of committing a crime.
manslaughter_text: Group A14 Manslaughter: the unlawful killing of another person while deprived of self-control by provocation, or with diminished responsibility, or without intent to kill through a careless, reckless, negligent, unlawful or dangerous act other than driving. It covers voluntary and involuntary manslaughter alike.
attempts_text: Group A12 Attempted murder and group A13 Accessory or conspiracy to murder are inside the A10 subdivision, so the count includes attempts (flag includes_attempts).
nonintent_text: Group A15 Driving causing death (an unlawful killing without intent through culpable, reckless or negligent driving) is inside A10, as is manslaughter without intent to kill.
other_text: A10 consists of the five groups A11 to A15 only; none concerns suicide or abortion.
legal_text: The classification defines the groups by offence and does not discuss legal intervention or justified killings.

title: Queensland, local government areas
term: Homicide (Murder) + Manslaughter (excl. by driving) + Manslaughter Unlawful Striking Causing Death
time_reference: Calendar year of REPORTING: the QPS statistics count offences when they are reported, not when they occurred.
murder_text: The QPS category is 'Homicide (Murder)'.
manslaughter_text: Two QPS categories are counted: 'Manslaughter (excl. by Driving & Striking)' and 'Manslaughter - Unlawful Striking Cause Death'. The second is an offence without intent to kill (a death caused by an unlawful strike), counted here with manslaughter.
attempts_text: Attempted Murder and Conspiracy to Murder are QPS categories inside 'Other Homicide' and are kept apart in the layer.
nonintent_text: Driving Causing Death is a separate QPS category inside 'Other Homicide' and is kept apart.
other_text: The QPS homicide categories are murder, attempted murder, conspiracy to murder, the two manslaughter categories and driving causing death; there is none for suicide or abortion. 'Other Homicide' is the sum of the categories other than murder (2016-17: 96 = 75 attempted murder + 0 conspiracy + 4 + 5 manslaughter + 12 driving).
legal_text: The QPS statistical reviews and the open-data dictionaries (whose description column is empty) do not define the categories or discuss legal intervention.

title: Western Australia, police districts
time_reference: Financial year July to June; `year` is the START year. The WA Police compile offences by the date they are reported or become known to the police (not the date of the offence), and the count may include offences committed in earlier periods.
murder_text: Murder: unlawfully killing another person with intent to kill, or with intent to cause bodily harm likely to endanger life, or by an act done in the prosecution of an unlawful purpose and likely to endanger life.
manslaughter_text: Manslaughter: the unlawful killing of another person under circumstances that do not amount to murder. It therefore covers killings without intent as well as provoked ones.
attempts_text: 'Attempted/Conspiracy to Murder' (the attempted unlawful killing of another person or conspiring to commit murder) is a separate line.
nonintent_text: 'Driving Causing Death' (an unlawful killing without intent through culpable, reckless or negligent driving) is a separate line. Other killings without intent that are recorded as manslaughter are inside the manslaughter count.
other_text: Murder (section 279) and manslaughter (section 280) are defined as the unlawful killing of another person, so suicide is outside. The WA Police series says nothing about abortion or concealment of birth.
legal_text: The glossary and the explanatory notes do not discuss legal intervention or justified killings; offences with the outcome status 'no criminal offence', 'offence substituted', 'false report' or 'entered in error' are excluded.
